title: Mixed Event — Special Present for You! — Episode8 Words for a Lovely Audience

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Words for a Lovely Audience
meta.Event Outline: Rui has received a request to write and direct a ski resort's Christmas show. This is the first script he's penned in some time, and it's apparently based on a Christmas episode from his own childhood...

rows.Line: After the performance
Ski Resort

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There we are...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Okay, I've finished moving all the chairs.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I should start helping Tsukasa and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We've finished loading everything up over here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you.
I was actually just about to ask if you needed any help, but it seems that won't be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... This means we were the fastest!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Cheerful Boy
rows.Line:
Today's show was so cool, Mom!
I had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Kind Mother
rows.Line: Me too. I was so blown away when those Santas skied right past us.

rows.Speaker: Cheerful Boy
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm glad that I got to help them!

rows.Speaker: Kind Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. So am I.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sounds like everyone enjoyed today's show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, even when we were packing everything up over there, we could hear people talking about how much fun they had.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. As the director, I couldn't be happier...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: Great show, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Azusawa, everyone.
Thank you all very much for helping! We owe you a debt of gratitude!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we had fun today as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't think any of us were expecting to see those Santa Clauses ski right past us. It was a pretty incredible scene.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only that, making lanterns together and seeing them all light up during the show was something I'll never forget!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither! It was a fun story with the way all the Santas fought, and the lanterns looked really pretty...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was such a dreamlike moment.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Getting to be a part of such a wonderful show is the best Christmas present I could've asked for!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone's smiling from ear to ear☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that very much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Today's show was made possible by you and the other guests, Azusawa. I have all of you to thank...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'd like to take this moment to express my gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you hadn't said that you'd like to help with the show, then I doubt I would've been able to come up with that idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'm so happy that you and your friends ended up enjoying the show so much, along with the rest of the guests.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, thank you for being such a lovely audience...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We aren't able to put on as many shows as we used to at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we promise to continue bringing you the best shows we can, so we hope that you'll keep supporting us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course! I'll be looking forward to seeing you all perform again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, since she's being so patient with us, that means we need to become better than ever...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We did run into some trouble along the way, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm glad that both the audience and everyone who volunteered to help us ended up enjoying the show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really do love shows that allow people to experience that sort of childlike wonder...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For the sake of those looking forward to seeing us do more shows in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I need to do what I can to become a much better director.)
